occurrences.text: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.
As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
The hills melted like wax at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
And the mountains shall be molten under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, and as the waters that are poured down a steep place.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
